Hammersmith & City.reason: Hammersmith and City Line: Minor delays between Liverpool Street and Barking due to an earlier customer incident. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.

Mildmay.reason: MILDMAY LINE: Sunday 2 August, a reduced service will run between Shepherds Bush and Clapham Junction. Trains will use platform 17 at Clapham Junction and will run an uneven service every 15/30 minutes, with additional Southern Railway services. Southern Railway services will not operate between Shepherds Bush and Watford Junction before 1200 and after 2100.

Trains continue to operate between Acton Town and Uxbridge. Use rail connections between Heathrow terminals. Replacement buses operate.

Waterloo & City.reason: Waterloo & City line: service operates 06:00 until 00:30, Monday to Friday only. There is no service on Saturdays, Sundays and on bank/public holidays.

Windrush.reason: WINDRUSH LINE: Sunday 2 August, no service between Wandsworth Road and Clapham Junction. Trains will divert to/from Battersea Park after Wandsworth Road. Use local buses via any reasonable route between Clapham Junction and Battersea Park / Surrey Quays or Southern trains between Battersea Park and Clapham Junction, where tickets will be accepted. In addition, the early Sunday morning train at 0001 from Highbury & Islington to Battersea Park will not run.
